en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large early‑20th‑century civic building beside an open square or broad street. The structure has a steep tiled roof with dormer windows, a central tower with a clock, and an arched entrance covered with ivy. The façade shows symmetrical windows and modest ornament typical of Central European municipal architecture. Trees and a small planted island with a single tree occupy the foreground, under a partly cloudy sky.
